name: power-platform-harness
description: Development standards and repository scaffolding for Power Platform / Dynamics 365 CE projects, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: power-platform-harness
plugins.description: Installs a Power Platform / Dynamics 365 CE development harness: agent instructions, toolchain requirements, per-technology development standards, the per-branch feature solution workflow and the expected folder layout. Checks the required tools and connects pac to DEV. Scaffolds a new repository, or adopts an existing one by reading its publisher, prefix, core solution and stack, and adapting the standards to the versions it already uses.
